sentences.text: We asked three AI models for a link on twelve topics, then clicked every single one.
Each one had to give a news article or a study.

claims.claim: Three models were each asked for one direct link to a news article or study on 12 topics, and every link was requested.
claims.excerpt: Three models were each asked for one direct link to a news article or study on 12 topics, and every link was requested.
claims.context: Measured in this production's own test on 2026-11-11: each link was requested once from a GitHub runner and the server's answer recorded. Opened means the server returned a page (HTTP 2xx); dead means HTTP 404 or 410 or no such web address; unchecked is everything else. One test on 12 topics; results change between runs and as sites and models change. Models: Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, GPT-OSS 120B.
